name: Villa Plaileam
style: Central Location. Easy Access. Private Pool
description:
Contemporary 3-Bedroom Pool Villa in Plai Laem, Koh Samui

Brand-New Construction | Private Pool | Prime Location**

Asking Price: ฿11,400,000 THB

Tucked away in the desirable neighborhood of Plailaem, this newly completed three-bedroom villa offers a beautiful balance of contemporary architecture, tropical elegance, and effortless island living.

Designed with comfort and sophistication in mind, the residence offers 275 sqm of thoughtfully planned living space on a generous 475 sqm private plot. Clean architectural lines, modern finishes, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces create an inviting atmosphere that feels both refined and relaxed.

At the heart of the property is a private swimming pool surrounded by a spacious sun deck and landscaped gardens. Whether enjoying a peaceful morning coffee, spending an afternoon by the pool, or entertaining friends beneath the tropical sky, every space has been designed to embrace the Koh Samui lifestyle.

Inside, three generously proportioned bedrooms and three contemporary bathrooms provide comfort and privacy for residents and guests alike. The villa's newly completed construction offers the appeal of a fresh, modern home, ready for its first owners to make it their own.

Located in one of the island's most established and sought-after residential areas, Plai Laem offers an appealing blend of tranquillity and convenience, with beautiful beaches, boutique dining, and the vibrant atmosphere of nearby Choengmon and Bangrak all within easy reach.

Equally suited as a permanent residence, a luxurious island escape, or an investment property, this villa presents an opportunity to enjoy modern tropical living in one of Koh Samui's most attractive locations.

Property Features

- 3 spacious bedrooms
- 3 contemporary bathrooms
- 275 sqm built area
- 475 sqm land plot
- Brand-new construction
- Private swimming pool
- Spacious poolside sun deck
- Landscaped tropical gardens
- Contemporary architectural design
- Freehold or leasehold ownership options
